texts: New Zealand population 2050 (million), Monte Carlo draws
P(cumulative LoE of AR ≤ 1), Theoretical Limit
note: P(within AR) = 0.640 (Wilson 0.627-0.653); (b) threshold 6.72 M (95% CI 6.71-6.72 M; Firth penalised likelihood (MLE does not exist), 2000 resamples). TL1 holds household size at 2.79 (1991, the highest observed) regardless of age structure: with the 2050 population this requires about 11.7% fewer households per person than in 2023 at every age. With an age-standardised TL1 (the lower of the 2023 and Stats NZ Medium B living-arrangement rates by age group; never below L1 Ambitious, which binds from 2040) TL is 5,946 kt, LoE AR 1.34, P(LoE AR ≤ 1) = 0.1% over the draws (the sensitivity row TL-TL1-age-standardised).
